ineligibility_states.INELIGIBLE_MISSING_AUTHORITY: The workload cell is missing required source/semantic/routing/validator authority. No candidate is invoked and this is not a candidate failure.
ineligibility_states.INELIGIBLE_CONFIGURED: Accepted workload authority explicitly marks the cell ineligible. No candidate failure.
ineligibility_states.INELIGIBLE_NONCOMPARABLE: Accepted authority says the requested comparison is noncomparable. No candidate failure and no numeric substitute.
ineligibility_states.INELIGIBLE_OUTSIDE_REQUESTED_JURISDICTIO: The cell lies outside the frozen workload jurisdiction.
ineligibility_states.INELIGIBLE_SOURCE_CELL_UNAVAILABLE: The named empirical universe/source cell is unavailable under current authority.
ineligibility_states.INELIGIBLE_UNRESOLVED_AUTHORITY: Required authority remains unresolved and is preserved as unresolved.

candidate_or_oracle_failures.CANDIDATE_LAUNCH_FAILURE: Physical adapter could not be launched.
candidate_or_oracle_failures.CANDIDATE_RESPONSE_MISSING: Candidate returned no governed response object.
candidate_or_oracle_failures.CANDIDATE_RESPONSE_INVALID: Candidate response violates the physical response contract.
candidate_or_oracle_failures.SEMANTIC_ORACLE_MISMATCH: Candidate semantic output hash differs from the frozen oracle; speed cannot rescue the cell.
candidate_or_oracle_failures.IDENTITY_ORACLE_MISMATCH: A frozen deterministic/release/replay identity differs from the oracle.
candidate_or_oracle_failures.MEASUREMENT_TELEMETRY_INCOMPLETE: Required source-open/decode telemetry is unavailable; missing is not treated as zero.
candidate_or_oracle_failures.HARNESS_ACTION_FAILURE: A candidate-neutral harness-owned delete/reset action failed.
